reddit.title: Introducing New Features: When the Colony Talks Back
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how your colony communicates with you. Settlers now display thought badges for their needs, and you'll receive alerts for problems directly on the HUD. This means you can address issues quickly without searching the grid. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

steam.title: New Communication Features in Provincia!
steam.body: In our latest update, your colony will now communicate its needs through thought badges, and you'll receive visual alerts for any issues that arise. This means you'll spend less time searching for problems and more time building your dream settlement. For a detailed look at these features, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back
